results.summary: The removal path conflicts with the independent P-code, and two edge cases are not faithfully modeled.
issues: At 0x006dd043, the P-code subtracts 1 from the value loaded from *entry at 0x006dd02b. The reversed code instead subtracts 1 from count_0xA0. This conflicts with the supplied Ghidra decompilation; the independent P-code supports the entry value.
When param_1 is zero, the binary masks incoming EAX. Reading uninitialized eax in C++ is undefined behavior.
The binary has no 32-entry bounds check. Indexing entry_0x20[32] is undefined in C++ if the computed index exceeds 31.
validation_findings: Candidate must contain exactly one complete function body
